```{r setup}
library(here)
library(dotenv)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# Load environment variables from project root .env
dotenv::load_dot_env(here::here(".env"))
output_data_dir <- Sys.getenv("OUTPUT_DATA_DIR")

eval_data_path <- file.path(output_data_dir, "eval", "data", "test_evaluation.csv")
inference_data_path <- file.path(output_data_dir, "inference", "data", "hybrid_model_predictions.csv")
eval_fig_dir <- file.path(output_data_dir, "eval", "figures")

if (!dir.exists(eval_fig_dir)) {
  dir.create(eval_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
eval_df <- read_csv(eval_data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
inference_df <- read_csv(inference_data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Eval data:", nrow(eval_df), "rows\n")
cat("Inference data:", nrow(inference_df), "rows\n")
cat("Eval conditions:", paste(unique(eval_df$game_sequence), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Inference conditions:", paste(unique(inference_df$game_sequence), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Process Eval (Synthetic Test) Data

```{r process-eval}
# Filter to:
#   1. demo/learner segments only (exclude bandit_sep and query structural tokens)
#   2. watch-first ordering only (matches human experiment: watch demo then play)
# Then compute game_index (0-indexed sequential numbering within each example)
eval_filtered <- eval_df %>%
  filter(segment_type %in% c("demo", "learner"),
         segment_order == "watch-first") %>%
  group_by(example_id) %>%
  mutate(game_index = row_number() - 1L) %>%
  ungroup()

# Pivot to long format: expert and novice N_tot_pred per game_index
eval_expert <- eval_filtered %>%
  select(example_id, game_index, game_sequence, n_total = expert_N_tot_pred) %>%
  mutate(demonstrator_type = "expert")

eval_novice <- eval_filtered %>%
  select(example_id, game_index, game_sequence, n_total = novice_N_tot_pred) %>%
  mutate(demonstrator_type = "novice")

eval_long <- bind_rows(eval_expert, eval_novice)

# Compute mean +/- SE by game_index, game_sequence, demonstrator_type
eval_summary <- eval_long %>%
  group_by(game_sequence, game_index, demonstrator_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_n_total = mean(n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_n_total = sd(n_total, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Eval segment_order distribution:\n")
print(table(eval_df$segment_order))
cat("\nUsing watch-first only:", n_distinct(eval_filtered$example_id), "examples\n")
cat("Eval game_index range:", range(eval_long$game_index), "\n")
```

## Process Inference (Human Experiment) Data

```{r process-inference}
# Function to parse beta string and calculate N_total (prior-subtracted to match eval)
# Eval computes: sum(alpha + beta) - K*(alpha0 + beta0), with alpha0=1, beta0=1, K=12 → subtract 24
parse_n_total <- function(beta_string, alpha0 = 1, beta0 = 1) {
  if (is.na(beta_string) || beta_string == "") {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  matches <- str_match_all(beta_string, "\\(([0-9.]+),\\s*([0-9.]+)\\)")[[1]]
  if (nrow(matches) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  alphas <- as.numeric(matches[, 2])
  betas <- as.numeric(matches[, 3])
  K <- length(alphas)
  return(sum(alphas + betas, na.rm = TRUE) - K * (alpha0 + beta0))
}

inference_processed <- inference_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_total_expert = parse_n_total(expert_betas),
    n_total_novice = parse_n_total(novice_betas)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Pivot to long format
inf_expert <- inference_processed %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_total_expert)) %>%
  distinct(session_id, game_sequence, game_index, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(session_id, game_sequence, game_index, n_total = n_total_expert) %>%
  mutate(demonstrator_type = "expert")

inf_novice <- inference_processed %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_total_novice)) %>%
  distinct(session_id, game_sequence, game_index, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(session_id, game_sequence, game_index, n_total = n_total_novice) %>%
  mutate(demonstrator_type = "novice")

inf_long <- bind_rows(inf_expert, inf_novice)

# Compute mean +/- SE by game_index, game_sequence, demonstrator_type
inf_summary <- inf_long %>%
  group_by(game_sequence, game_index, demonstrator_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_n_total = mean(n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_n_total = sd(n_total, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 2x2 N_total Comparison Figure

```{r ntot-comparison, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Color palette
colors <- c(expert = "#1f77b4", novice = "#d62728")

# Shared y-axis limits across all 4 plots
y_limits <- c(
  min(0, min(eval_long$n_total, na.rm = TRUE), min(inf_long$n_total, na.rm = TRUE)),
  max(eval_long$n_total, na.rm = TRUE, inf_long$n_total) * 1.05
)

# Shared x-axis breaks
x_breaks <- 0:11

# Common plot builder (works for both eval and inference data)
make_plot <- function(data_summary, data_individual, condition, title_label) {
  data_summary <- data_summary %>% filter(game_sequence == condition)
  data_individual <- data_individual %>% filter(game_sequence == condition)

  # Build x-axis labels: expert-first watches Expert at 0,4,8 and Novice at 2,6,10
  expert_first <- grepl("^expert", condition)
  first_watch <- if (expert_first) "Expert" else "Novice"
  second_watch <- if (expert_first) "Novice" else "Expert"
  x_labels <- rep(c(first_watch, "Play", second_watch, "Play"), 3)

  ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = game_index, y = mean_n_total, color = demonstrator_type)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(3.5, 7.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_n_total - se_n_total,
                      ymax = mean_n_total + se_n_total),
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_jitter(
      data = data_individual,
      aes(x = game_index, y = n_total, color = demonstrator_type),
      width = 0.3, height = 0, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_limits[2] * 0.97, label = "Round 1",
             fontface = "bold", size = 3.5, color = "gray30") +
    annotate("text", x = 5.5, y = y_limits[2] * 0.97, label = "Round 2",
             fontface = "bold", size = 3.5, color = "gray30") +
    annotate("text", x = 9.5, y = y_limits[2] * 0.97, label = "Round 3",
             fontface = "bold", size = 3.5, color = "gray30") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, labels = c(expert = "Expert", novice = "Novice")) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 0:11,
      labels = x_labels
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = title_label,
      x = "Game Type",
      y = expression(N[total]),
      color = "Demonstrator"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Build the 2x2 grid
p_tl <- make_plot(eval_summary, eval_long, "expert-play-novice-play-choice", "Simulated Test Data: Expert First")
p_tr <- make_plot(inf_summary, inf_long, "expert-play-novice-play-choice", "Human Experiment: Expert First")
p_bl <- make_plot(eval_summary, eval_long, "novice-play-expert-play-choice", "Simulated Test Data: Novice First")
p_br <- make_plot(inf_summary, inf_long, "novice-play-expert-play-choice", "Human Experiment: Novice First")

combined <- (p_tl | p_tr) / (p_bl | p_br) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Demonstrator Experience Predictions",
    subtitle = "Simulated test data vs Human experiment data by condition",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

# Extract legend from one plot
legend_plot <- make_plot(eval_summary, eval_long, "expert-play-novice-play-choice", "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 25)))
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# Combine with shared legend
final_plot <- combined / wrap_elements(legend_grob) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.08))

print(final_plot)

# Save figure
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(eval_fig_dir, "ntot_comparison.png"),
  plot = final_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 150, bg = "white"
)
cat("\nFigure saved to:", file.path(eval_fig_dir, "ntot_comparison.png"), "\n")
```
